title: Affine-local cohomology classes detect maps out of ordinary higher direct image
statement: Let f:X→Y be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and p∈ℕ. For each open V of Y put U=f⁻¹(V), j_U:U→X, let H_U^p be module cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology] on U, and forget its global scalar action. There are natural transformations in the coefficient O_X-module M, c_V: H_U^p(j_U^*(-))→Γ(V,R^p f_*(-)), where restriction is [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] and ordinary module higher direct image is [pqf-def-cohomology]. For every module N on X [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], module Q on Y, and maps a,b:R^p f_*N→Q, if c_V(N) followed by Γ(V,a) equals c_V(N) followed by Γ(V,b) for every affine open V, then a=b. No compactness, quasi-separatedness, quasi-coherence, family, or coproduct hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Lemma 20.7.3; coefficient naturality of the injective-resolution comparison, using Lemma 20.7.1 (Tag 01E1)

proof.text: Apply the coefficient-natural comparison lemma. For N choose an injective resolution I, set K=f_*I, and let T be canonical theta followed by the inverse resolution comparison. The comparison lemma identifies c_V(N) with an isomorphism e_V followed by T(V).

For maps a,b out of R^p f_*N with equal composites on affine opens, cancel e_V on every affine open. This gives equality of the affine components of the underlying additive presheaf maps T followed by a and T followed by b. The affine opens form a basis (Scheme.isBasis_affineOpens). Mathlib TopCat.Sheaf.hom_ext, with target the underlying additive sheaf of Q, extends this equality to equality of presheaf morphisms. Faithfulness of PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf gives equality of module-presheaf morphisms. This avoids any construction of stalk representatives.

Apply the unique factorization clause of higherDirectImagePresheaf to the common module-presheaf map. Functor.map_comp and associativity show that both a and b satisfy the defining equation. Uniqueness gives a=d and b=d, hence a=b.

theorem higherDirectImage_affine_cohomology_presentation
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (p : ℕ) :
    ∃ c : ∀ V : Y.Opens,
      Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι ⋙
        RingedSpace.moduleCohomology (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace p ⋙
          forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u}
            ((moduleRings (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace).obj.obj (Opposite.op ⊤)))
              AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⟶
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p ⋙
        RingedSpace.openModuleSections Y.toRingedSpace V,
      ∀ (N : X.Modules) (Q : Y.Modules)
        (a b : ((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage f.toLRSHom.toShHom).rightDerived p).obj N ⟶ Q),
        (∀ (V : Y.Opens), IsAffineOpen V →
          (c V).app N ≫ (RingedSpace.openModuleSections Y.toRingedSpace V).map a =
            (c V).app N ≫ (RingedSpace.openModuleSections Y.toRingedSpace V).map b) →
        a = b
